projectMetadata.description: A comprehensive web suite for independent USANA distributors, featuring a public-facing landing page and private, offline-first business tools.

architecture.frontend: Vanilla JS, HTML, CSS (Vite build tool)

items.label: Shared components dir (NavBar, ToolShell, DataTable, ImportWizard)

manualTasks.label: Portrait/Landscape Composition Pass (Phase 4)
manualTasks.instructions: Manually test all views on both mobile (portrait) and desktop (landscape) viewport dimensions. Verify that data tables scroll horizontally without breaking layout, sidebars collapse correctly, and touch targets are adequately sized on mobile.

manualTasks.label: Accessibility (a11y) Pass (Phase 4)
manualTasks.instructions: Ensure the application is fully keyboard navigable (using Tab, Enter, and Space). Check that all text meets WCAG AA color contrast ratios against backgrounds, and verify that reduced-motion media queries are respected for animations like the landing page progress rail.

manualTasks.label: Initial GitHub Pages Deployment (Phase 7)
manualTasks.instructions: Confirm that the `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` action has successfully completed at least one run and that the site is live, accessible, and correctly serving the Vite bundle on the expected `gh-pages` URL.
